title: Fire department budget request with 10 new positions
summary: On November 21, 2024, the commission voted to send the mayor a letter supporting the fire department's budget. The fire chief had proposed 10 new positions costing about $555,000 in the first year. The department also planned to rent a three- or four-bedroom house for off-duty firefighters working away from home.
